description: Answers 'copy this published strategy and change one thing.' Give a slug and changes (nested fields merged, e.g. signal lookback 252 to 126); optionally a new title. Returns the fork's slug and page URL. Re-runs the strategy on the server and publishes the fork linked to its parent. Costs one backtest. If the slug is unknown, the error says so - call list_strategies or get_strategy to find a valid slug first.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: fork_strategy
title: Fork strategy
